name: Sono Kubiwa o Hanasanaide ~Ookami o Tabetai Akazukin to Akazukin o Tabetai Ryoushi~
original_name: その首輪を離さないで～狼を食べたい赤ずきんと赤ずきんを食べたい猟師～
source:
Everything's all messed up!

A yuri comedy ADV taking place in a world of fairy tales starring Red Riding Hood herself!

Guide Little Red Riding Hood around as she gets into
all sorts of shenanigans on her search for some adult fun...
